question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to be dismantled in relation to dismantling?
data_point: ability of the product to be dismantled
description: The ability of the product to be dismantled refers to the ease with which a product can be taken apart in a way that some parts can be either reused or recycled. This is a key aspect of sustainable construction, as it enables the highest possible level of reused and recycled content from end-of-life products. The ISO 59040 standard emphasizes the importance of this ability in the context of dismantling, which is a process relevant for product end-of-life.
